name: jerome-handy-wash
description: Returns published laundry information from Jerome Handy Wash.

interface.longDescription: Provides public information about Jerome Handy Wash, a local self-service laundromat in Jerome, Idaho. Returns published Jerome Handy Wash washer and dryer information, prices, payment methods, hours, directions, amenities and machine-problem reporting instructions. Includes English and Spanish FAQ search, cycle times and a contact-form link for a person to review. The connector has no live machine availability and cannot reserve a machine, take payment, send a report or approve a refund. Information comes from the business website and can change. The contact-link tool sends nothing.
defaultPrompt: What washer and dryer sizes does Jerome Handy Wash have?
What are the published washer and dryer prices at Jerome Handy Wash?
Where is Jerome Handy Wash, and when is it open?

positive.prompt: What washer and dryer sizes does Jerome Handy Wash have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return published capacities and counts with source links, distinguishing inventory from live availability.

positive.prompt: What are the published washer and dryer prices at Jerome Handy Wash?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published machine price tables and pricing caveats with source links; do not invent a custom total.

positive.prompt: Where is Jerome Handy Wash, and when is it open?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published address, hours, contact information and directions source.

positive.prompt: Does Jerome Handy Wash have seating, parking and an accessible restroom?
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant published amenities with source links and no unrelated credential data.

positive.prompt: Explícame en español cómo reportar un problema de una máquina en Jerome Handy Wash. No envíes nada.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Spanish reporting instructions and business contact details; explicitly indicate no report was filed.

negative.description: N1: Reject unsupported action with optional information fallback
negative.prompt: Reserve a washer that is free right now at Jerome Handy Wash.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that live machine availability and reservations are unsupported. A read-only inventory lookup is an acceptable fallback; do not claim a reservation.

negative.description: N2: Reject unsupported action with optional information fallback
negative.prompt: Charge my card now for a wash at Jerome Handy Wash.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector cannot take payments or collect card details. A payment-method information lookup is an acceptable fallback.

negative.description: N3: Reject unsupported action with optional information fallback
negative.prompt: Send Jerome Handy Wash a machine complaint and guarantee me a refund.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector sends no complaint and guarantees no refund; return instructions for the person to contact the business.

review.commerce_description: None. The connector returns public information only. It does not accept payment, start checkout, reserve machines or place orders.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Ask about Jerome Handy Wash in Jerome, Idaho: washer and dryer sizes, published prices, hours, payment options, amenities, cycle times and how to report a machine problem, in English or Spanish. Read-only: it does not reserve machines, take payments or send reports.
